channel.title: Wire — Programming
channel.description: Programming from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: How we saved 100 terabytes of memory by optimizing 1.1.1.1’s DNS cache
item.description: Five Rust-level memory optimizations to the DNS cache layout of Big Pineapple cut per-entry memory by 56%, freeing approximately 100 TB of memory across Cloudflare's fleet. (4 sources: cloudflare, hackernews, lobsters, rprogramming)

item.title: Hilariously fast volume computation with the divergence theorem (2018)
Understanding Go's sync.Map from API to Hash Trie
item.description: Go’s sync.Map now uses a hash trie. This article builds the implementation from a normal map, then explains lock-free reads, fine-grained writer locking, collisions, retries, deletion, Clear, Range, and the trade-offs against map plus… (2 sources: golangweekly, lobsters)

item.title: Hunting Down a Go Runtime Bug on 32-bit Embedded Systems
item.description: A customer's Go application kept crashing on a 32-bit embedded Linux system. We traced the fatal netpoll error to a pointer aliasing bug in the Go runtime. (2 sources: golangweekly, lobsters)

item.title: Everything I own, owned
item.description: Turning Claude loose on the firmware of five USB and WiFi peripherals, and finding a command shell in a microphone, a defeatable webcam activity LED, and unauthenticated memory writes over the network. (2 sources: golangweekly, lobsters)
